pages.text: $(li)For multi-slice setups, hold shift when placing a cell to copy the configuration of the cell you target (works for MSR too)$(li)Ensure water and hot fluid flow in opposite directions—this is required for heat exchange efficiency
$(li)In modular multiblocks, fluid input order does not affect function; in heat exchangers, the water and the hot fluid must flow in opposite directions
$(li)For 2-phase heat exchangers, additional slices increase processing speed

$(li)For MSR/heat exchanger chains, alternate default and input spread, with product out on the last slice (e.g., default → input spread → default → input spread → default → product out for a three-slice MSR)
$(li)The heat exchanger for the Fluid Crystal Matrix does not require actual heat; surrounding the tube with buckets of Redstone is sufficient
